@overview 字彙王 Level 3–5 練習題本。答案與中文詞義已與教材官方解答逐題核對；題目文字為照片轉錄。

@group A 文意字彙（1–5）：依提示寫出正確的字

Q 1 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: According to an official from the Ministry of A______e, the price of vegetables increased by 15% after the typhoon.
= agriculture
~詞義 agriculture（n.）農業
~原文 According to an official from the Ministry of agriculture, the price of vegetables increased by 15% after the typhoon.

Q 2 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The government offers free health check-ups for every s______r citizen over the age of sixty-five.
= senior
~詞義 senior（adj.）長者(senior citizen)
~原文 The government offers free health check-ups for every senior citizen over the age of sixty-five.

Q 3 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The speaker's e______e face and passionate tone helped to maintain the audience's attention.
= expressive
~詞義 expressive（adj.）富表達力的
~原文 The speaker's expressive face and passionate tone helped to maintain the audience's attention.

Q 4 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Because of her excellent performance in all of her classes, Jane won a ______ (scholar) to Harvard University.
= scholarship
~詞義 scholarship（n.）獎學金
~原文 Because of her excellent performance in all of her classes, Jane won a scholarship to Harvard University.

Q 5 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The sudden rain was so ______ (expectation) that everyone at the park had to run for shelter.
= unexpected
~詞義 unexpected（adj.）出乎意料的
~原文 The sudden rain was so unexpected that everyone at the park had to run for shelter.

@group B 選擇題（6–10）

Q 6 | choice | 選擇題
stem: In the middle of the night, Cindy was ______ by a loud noise. She then sat up and looked out of the window to see what was happening.
A: conveyed
B: educated
C: surveyed
D: awakened
= D
~詞義 awaken（v.）喚醒;叫醒
~原文 In the middle of the night, Cindy was awakened by a loud noise. She then sat up and looked out of the window to see what was happening.

Q 7 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Once Roger knew that he had passed the exam, he ______ a sigh of relief.
A: dared
B: labeled
C: breathed
D: hired
= C
~詞義 breathe（v.）呼吸
~原文 Once Roger knew that he had passed the exam, he breathed a sigh of relief.

Q 8 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The teacher asked students to rate their stress level on a ______ of one to five.
A: scale
B: captain
C: gap
D: definition
= A
~詞義 scale（n.）等級
~原文 The teacher asked students to rate their stress level on a scale of one to five.

Q 9 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Playing too many violent video games may influence a child's ______ development.
A: mental
B: costly
C: elderly
D: historic
= A
~詞義 mental（adj.）心理的
~原文 Playing too many violent video games may influence a child's mental development.

Q 10 | choice | 選擇題
stem: 2020 was a ______ year for everyone, but many people helped one another to overcome their difficulties.
A: physical
B: capable
C: tough
D: rough
= C
~詞義 tough（adj.）艱難的
~原文 2020 was a tough year for everyone, but many people helped one another to overcome their difficulties.

@group C 配合題（11–15）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: editing
B: scholar
C: campus
D: hiring
E: salary
F: pat

Q 11 | bank | 配合題
stem: Karen is ______ a book, deciding what will be removed and what will be kept in before it goes to print.
= A
~詞義 edit（v.）編輯
~原文 Karen is editing a book, deciding what will be removed and what will be kept in before it goes to print.

Q 12 | bank | 配合題
stem: To meet the increasing demand of consumers, the factory is ______ more workers so that it can manufacture products more quickly.
= D
~詞義 hire（v.）僱用
~原文 To meet the increasing demand of consumers, the factory is hiring more workers so that it can manufacture products more quickly.

Q 13 | bank | 配合題
stem: The company determines each worker's ______ based on work experience and educational background.
= E
~詞義 salary（n.）薪水
~原文 The company determines each worker's salary based on work experience and educational background.

Q 14 | bank | 配合題
stem: A medical ______ pointed out that drinking coffee every day was beneficial for the human body.
= B
~詞義 scholar（n.）學者
~原文 A medical scholar pointed out that drinking coffee every day was beneficial for the human body.

Q 15 | bank | 配合題
stem: The university has the largest ______ in the country, covering about 40,000,000 square meters.
= C
~詞義 campus（n.）校園
~原文 The university has the largest campus in the country, covering about 40,000,000 square meters.

@group C 配合題（16–20）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: capable
B: assume
C: survey
D: airline
E: paradise
F: junior

Q 16 | bank | 配合題
stem: The island is a(n) ______ for bird lovers. It has hundreds of species of birds.
= E
~詞義 paradise（n.）天堂
~原文 The island is a(n) paradise for bird lovers. It has hundreds of species of birds.

Q 17 | bank | 配合題
stem: According to a recent ______, almost four fifths of college students in the country have to take on part-time jobs to get by.
= C
~詞義 survey（n.）調查
~原文 According to a recent survey, almost four fifths of college students in the country have to take on part-time jobs to get by.

Q 18 | bank | 配合題
stem: People often ______ Fanny to be unfriendly, but she's actually quite warm once you get to know her.
= B
~詞義 assume（v.）認為
~原文 People often assume Fanny to be unfriendly, but she's actually quite warm once you get to know her.

Q 19 | bank | 配合題
stem: A(n) ______ is a student in the third year of a course that lasts for four years at a college or university.
= F
~詞義 junior（n.）(大學)三年級生
~原文 A(n) junior is a student in the third year of a course that lasts for four years at a college or university.

Q 20 | bank | 配合題
stem: The chef is ______ of identifying at least five hundred flavors.
= A
~詞義 capable（adj.）有能力的
~原文 The chef is capable of identifying at least five hundred flavors.
